At the critical Boolean moment exponent, this change proves a dimension-free transfer gap for budgets sufficiently close to one and constructs strictly positive densities with a uniform floor and stretched-exponentially closing gaps for every fixed B>2. It balances one product tilt against the uniform spectral channel and integrates both results into the existing grouped manuscript.

The full analytical source audit accepts unchanged G1–G8 at 2d1d27c4ba5f677e7f51092c6479735ba9ba59fa. Its complete report, source bindings and limitations are retained. The optimal critical budget and external priority remain unestablished. title: Critical moment budgets: stability near one and balanced-tilt collapse
